stem:
A teacher bought markers at a cost of $3 per set. The teacher had a $2-off coupon to use toward the total cost of the markers bought.

Which table shows the relationship between x, the number of sets of markers bought by the teacher, and y, the total cost of the markers?

options.label: A
options.text:
Sets of Markers Bought, x  | Total Cost, y
3  | $7
9  | $25
12 | $34
24 | $70
